name: Project Rescue
headline: A clear next step for a *stalled website*.
promise: Half-built, broken, hacked or just outdated: send us what you have and we review it, then quote either a repair or a rebuild with a written scope and schedule. You decide before any paid work starts.

included.title: A plain review
included.text: We look at the files, hosting, domain and settings you can share and explain in plain words what is wrong.

included.title: Repair or rebuild, with reasons
included.text: Sometimes fixing is right, sometimes rebuilding costs less than patching. You get both options and our recommendation.

included.title: Security cleanup
included.text: Where the scope covers it: suspicious code removed, passwords changed and unused admin accounts closed.

included.title: Speed and mobile fixes
included.text: Pages rebuilt or repaired for phones first and checked with Lighthouse on mobile before launch.

included.title: Redirects for old pages
included.text: Old addresses redirected to their new pages so visitors and Google can follow them. Rankings after a rebuild are never guaranteed.

included.title: Handover in your name
included.text: Domain, hosting access and content documented and handed to you, as written in the agreement.

process.text: The address, any logins you hold and what went wrong.
What we found, repair or rebuild, the price and the schedule.
Work starts after you approve the quote and the first payment.
Redirects checked, logins handed over, notes on what was changed.

faqs.q: My old developer has my domain and hosting logins. Can you help?
faqs.a: Usually the domain can be recovered through the registrar when it is registered to you. We help you through the steps; we never take ownership of it.

faqs.q: How do you decide between repairing and rebuilding?
faqs.a: By cost and risk. If the fix costs close to a rebuild or leaves the site fragile, we recommend rebuilding and say why.

faqs.q: Will I lose my Google rankings if you rebuild?
faqs.a: Redirects keep what Google already knows about your old pages, but nobody can promise rankings stay the same after a rebuild.

faqs.q: My WordPress site was hacked. Is that in scope?
faqs.a: It can be. We review it first; cleanup, hardening or a rebuild are quoted separately depending on what we find.
It depends on what we find. If a three-page rebuild covers it, the Business package price of ₹17,999 applies; anything larger is quoted in writing first.

cta: Send us the address of the stalled site, and we will reply with what we see and the options.
